glosses: are (SI unit of area equal to 100 square metres)
area, field (the extent, scope, or range of an object or concept)

examples.text: La mayoría de la gente vive en áreas urbanas.
examples.en: Most people live in urban areas.
Do you know the area well?

examples.text: En Canadá hay muchas áreas donde es ilegal talar árboles.
examples.en: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
